terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: Yozakura uses your terminal to launch the tmux manager and show update progress.

x-settings.keywords: terminal emulator kitty foot alacritty wezterm ghostty

terminalAdvanced.title: Advanced options
terminalAdvanced.description: Use a custom command template for terminals that do not accept the standard `-e` flag

terminalCommand.title: Open with
terminalCommand.description: $TERMINAL is replaced by the terminal above, $COMMAND by what the shell runs. Examples: "gnome-terminal -- $COMMAND", "konsole -e $COMMAND".

onboardingDone.title: Onboarding done
onboardingDone.description: The first-run setup wizard was finished or skipped. Set to false (or run `onboarding`) to show it again.

newLookOffered.title: New look offered
newLookOffered.description: The one-time "Try the new look" card was answered (tried, kept, reverted or dismissed); it is not shown again.

autoSavePreset.title: Save changes into my preset automatically
autoSavePreset.description: While one of your own presets is active, changed settings are written into it. Built-in presets are never changed.

x-settings.label: prefs.presets.autosave
x-settings.keywords: auto save preset automatically active current own changes

settingsShowAll.title: Show all settings
settingsShowAll.description: Settings window view. false = Simple: each page shows its essentials; true = All: expert rows (flagged advanced) too. Search always covers everything.
